de.name: Legga Obsi
de.text: Legga Obsi ist ein natürlicher Berggipfel in der Küstenregion in der Nähe der Horizon Djibouti Terminals.

hu.name: Legga Obsi
hu.text: A Legga Obsi egy természetes hegycsúcs, amely a Horizon Djibouti Terminals közelében fekvő partvidéken található.

ro.name: Legga Obsi
ro.text: Legga Obsi este un vârf muntos natural situat în regiunea de coastă, lângă terminalele Horizon Djibouti.

en.name: Legga Obsi
en.text: Legga Obsi is a natural mountain peak located in the coastal region near the Horizon Djibouti Terminals.
